definitions.short: properly, a concealer , i.e. a covert
definitions.full: H4565. mistar מִסְתָּר noun [masculine] secret place, hiding place ; — absolute ׳מ Psa 10:9 ; Hab 3:14 ; usually plural מִסְתָּרִים Jer 13:17 6 t.; suffix מִסְתָּרָיו 49:10 ; — 1 secret place(s) , concealed from view, Jer 13:17 ; where treasures are stored Isa 45:3 . 2 hiding-place(s): a. for protection Jer 23:24 ; 49:10 . b. for perpetration of crime, especially murder: Psa 10:8 (|| מַאֲרָב ), simile of lion 10:9 , 17:12 , compare Hab 3:14 ; Psa 64:5 ; of ׳י lying in wait Lam 3:10 (as a lion).
